description: Advance production identity and banner to Release 1261 Mara Anticipation, Worry & Protective Initiative.

replacements.old:
"ZORK1 MARA LIVED FEELING RUPTURE AND REPAIR GLULX for
  Zork I: The Great Underground Empire
  (c) Copyright 1983 Infocom, Inc. All Rights Reserved."

;"Repository-local Mara Lived Feeling, Rupture & Repair. Release 1260 lets
  specific events acquire authored personal meaning: chosen recklessness can
  produce concerned anger, intentional violence creates remembered betrayal and
  physical distance, and later concrete behavior can earn renewed cooperation
  without deleting the event that required repair. No generic emotion engine."
replacements.new:
"ZORK1 MARA ANTICIPATION WORRY AND PROTECTIVE INITIATIVE GLULX for
  Zork I: The Great Underground Empire
  (c) Copyright 1983 Infocom, Inc. All Rights Reserved."

;"Repository-local Mara Anticipation, Worry & Protective Initiative. Release
  1261 lets specific remembered danger alter future behavior before another
  injury: Mara can recognize the live risk, warn without waiting for a fall,
  truthfully prepare what she has, and remember whether the warning changed the
  player's later action. No generic worry meter or autonomous puzzle solver."
